lines.zh: 四只脚踩出同一种节奏
lines.en: Four feet drumming one rhythm.
Nose to the ground, I trot.
The mane along my spine lifts a little.
I follow the tail ahead of me.
Five of us fan out as we walk.
We flatten the grass into a road.
My jaw is heavier than any hyena's.
Circling upwind to catch the scent.

lines.zh: 脚爪落地几乎没有声音
lines.en: My paws land almost silently.
At a dead tree, I stop to sniff.
A packmate on the left, me on the right.
A bone clacks softly in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我边走边看你有没有跟来
lines.en: Walking, I check if you're following.
My shoulders rise and fall with each step.
There's carrion somewhere near here.
The pack scatters behind the shrubs.
My prints run a size bigger than a dog's.

lines.zh: 我们走成一条不断的长线
lines.en: We walk as one unbroken line.
I sit, ears pointed forward.
Scratching my neck with a hind paw.
My tongue sweeps across my muzzle.
Packmates nip at each other's ears.
I lift my nose into the wind.
My teeth grind with a grating sound.

lines.zh: 盯着远处一群食草动物
lines.en: Eyes fixed on grazing animals far off.
My tail lies flat against the ground.
A packmate leans in and nuzzles me.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出短促的哼声
lines.en: A short huff escapes my throat.
Head tilted, I watch the clouds move.
I rest my chin on my forepaws.
A quick count. We're all here.
I stand abruptly, then settle again.
Wind runs through my short coat.
Only breathing breaks the quiet.
There is no kindness in my eyes.
I open my jaws a crack.
You're on my list.
Rising slowly, in no hurry.
My packmates turn their heads your way.
Your scent is new here.
I tilt my head, showing that row of teeth.

lines.zh: 这一眼是最后一次警告
lines.en: This look is your last warning.
My legs stay still, but my jaw shifts.
Watching whatever you're holding.
A growl rolls up from my chest.

lines.zh: 看你的眼神像看一块肉
lines.en: I look at you the way I look at meat.
Pain drags a yelp out of me.
I back off, teeth still bared.
The pack presses in around me.
The wound on my shoulder burns.
That blow has made me furious.
I retreat, growling as I go.
These legs still hold me.
My blood makes the pack wilder.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，重新找角度
lines.en: I crouch, hunting a new angle.

lines.zh: 别以为打中一次就够了
lines.en: One hit doesn't finish this.
Meat! The whole pack smells it.
Not enough for five mouths.
I go first. You line up behind.
That greasy smell is pulling me in.
It's the crack of bone I love.
Don't hand-feed me. I'll bite you.
My drool drips onto the grass.
Packmates are already squabbling.
Just throw the whole thing over.
Once this is gone, I'll look at you again.
Half a steak still clings to the bone.
I stare at your hand without blinking.
Meat now means one less bite for you.

lines.zh: 这点香味够勾我一段路
lines.en: That smell will pull me a long way.
Throw it far. I'll beat you to it.

lines.zh: 我舔舔鼻子，油脂味来了。
lines.en: I lick my nose; the fat smell arrives.
A low growl, and I give half a step.
Bumping me means bumping the pack.
One shove of my shoulder moves you.
Don't touch the mane on my back.
My teeth are right by your wrist.
Packmates close half a circle.
Now I've marked your scent.
Back off. I hate fighting this close.
My claws left a mark on your boots.
You'd better run. Now.
I rub my neck against hers.
We bury half a kill together.
She takes the rear. I hold the front.
We grip each other's muzzles gently.
This litter will bring three or four.

lines.zh: 我给她叼来最好的一块
lines.en: I bring her the choicest piece.

lines.zh: 我们睡在同一个浅坑里
lines.en: We sleep in the same shallow pit.
She growls. I step back a pace.
Two tails twist together.
Tomorrow's hunt, we walk it together.
I bite down and shake my head.
The bone breaks between my teeth.
I run back to the pack with it.
This one is mine. Nobody touch it.
Too eager. It slipped out.
Hiding it before someone steals it.
Eating and growling a warning.
Two chews and it's down.
A scrap is stuck in my teeth.
A packmate's nose is right here.
Scent locked. It's you.
Ears up, and the pack understands.
I crouch and take the left.
That wasn't a bark. It was a signal.
Your legs are shorter than mine.
This grass is too tall for a clean run.
We close in from three sides.
My teeth are already grinding.

lines.zh: 你听见背后的脚步了吗
lines.en: Hear those footsteps behind you?
This meal must feed five.
No more noise. Just following.
We rotate who leads the chase.

lines.zh: 你每回一次头，都慢一点
lines.en: Every glance back costs you speed.
Endurance is our real weapon.
You tire. We wait.
The one on your left just swapped out.
The gap in the ring is closing.

lines.zh: 你的气味留在每一棵草上
lines.en: Your scent is on every blade of grass.

lines.zh: 我们不怕你手里的东西
lines.en: We're not afraid of what you're holding.
A little further and there's no retreat.
My jaws clamp onto your calf.
Twenty-six points of pain, and bone creaks.
I bite and haul backward.
A packmate lands the second bite.
This bite found the gap in your armor.
My jaws close and the blood comes.
I slam into your knee from the side.
Missed, and my teeth rattle numb.
Forepaw pins you, then another bite.
I lunge roaring, careless of danger.

lines.zh: 一群影子从灌木里出来
lines.en: A pack of shadows leaves the brush.
I'm the first head to poke out.
My paws rake the loose soil.
No other hunters in this range.
I smell prey on the wind.

lines.zh: 仰头叫了一声，召集同伴
lines.en: I lift my head and call the pack.

lines.zh: 短短几声，回应从四面来
lines.en: Short calls answer from every side.
Soil, grass, and blood in the air.
I shake my coat and the hair stands up.

lines.zh: 五只并排站着，看同一个方向
lines.en: Five of us stand abreast, facing one way.
One growl, and the pack moves.
We're claiming this ground again.
My coat catches fire and I roll.
My foreleg buckles as I land.
I thrash desperately in the water.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀起来又摔下
lines.en: The blast lifts me and drops me.
Something buries itself in my ribs.
This pain burns from the inside out.
Too starved even to growl.

lines.zh: 雷击让我的腿抽了一下
lines.en: Lightning makes my leg spasm.
No ground. We're all falling.
